author: Apple
description:
The new MacBook Pro with M6 delivers blazing-fast performance and the longest battery life ever in a Mac — up to 24 hours. M6 joins M5 Pro and M5 Max to create Apple’s most advanced lineup of pro laptop chips. Featuring a Liquid Retina XDR display with 1600 nits of peak HDR brightness, a 12MP Center Stage camera, and a studio-quality three-mic array. And when you need power fast, it can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes.

Pre-order the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starting at 10:10 a.m. PT on October 28. Available starting November 6.

Learn more: https://apple.co/4dZWgun

Battery life varies by use and configuration. See https://www.apple.com/batteries/ for more information. Fast charge tested using 96W power adapter. Charge time varies with settings and environmental factors.

description:

Pre-order the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starting at 10:10 a.m. PT on October 28. Available starting November 6.

Learn more: https://apple.co/4snEg2N
